Exchange rate — Transactions

This screen displays all transactions that are using the selected exchange rate.

When you modify an exchange rate, existing transactions continue to use their original rates unless you specifically update them.

Updating Transactions

To apply the new exchange rate to multiple transactions at once, select the transactions you want to update and click the Batch Update button.

Only transactions that currently have a different exchange rate will be updated - transactions already using the current rate are automatically excluded.
